method: Optuna TPE sampler, 40 trials, optimizing validation WAPE
verdict: Tuning improved val WAPE (23.06% -> 23.05%) but did NOT meaningfully improve test WAPE (23.05% -> 23.21%). This is a validation-set overfit: the search found hyperparameters that fit val's specific noise, not a generalizable improvement. The untuned baseline champion remains in production.
